answer: The cedar assignment is published and echo records each panel. Shards are assigned from the river graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4138 identities would post 2567 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
